reason: Every other function in the dodopayments lib files annotates its return (getDodoPaymentsClient(): DodoPayments, getProducts: Promise<Product[]>, etc. in nextjs and react lib files); nextjs/lib/dodopayments.ts:225 checkout omits it and leaks Promise<any>, while its react twin declares Promise<{ checkout_url: string }>, so it is drift, not a need. Not TRIVIAL: eslint.config.cjs has no explicit-function-return-type rule and tsc never requires return annotations (root tsconfig also excludes packages/*).
